'''Tothis''' was a lackluster [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Tothis system/Legends|Tothis system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The [[Authority Guardian Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Tothis to the [[Atchorb system/Legends|Atchorb]] and [[Kir system/Legends|Kir systems]].<ref name="Atlas" />

[[Musician/Legends|Musicians]] [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]] and [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] worked for a [[Time/Legends|time]] at<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|155|Jendowanian, Greeata}}</ref> the [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] [[Green Planet]] on Tothis. They were the only employees there who were not addicted to [[Spice/Legends|spice]],<ref name="SWI 67" /> and in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> a conflict that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> musician [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]] visited the Green Planet while looking for members to join [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers|his band]], ultimately hiring both Jendowanian and Snootles.<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tothis was first mentioned in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed it in grid square S-3.<ref name="Atlas" />
